name: sdlc-model-council
description: Cross-model council: onboard the AI models reachable via locally installed peer agentic CLIs (codex, agy, opencode; extensible via one-directory adapters) by assessing them against a standardized problem stack, cast them into roles (a roster), and run cross-model fan-out plays (diff+synthesis, consensus, best-of-N, generator↔verifier) chosen per project. Built on a unified delegation contract with graded permission postures. In-session and uncontainerised — distinct from sdlc-workflows (Archon/Docker/DAG).
